caption: The drawing depicts a single green drinking cup with a handle, positioned in the center of the composition. The cup is placed on a circular grey plate with visible signs of texture and wear, indicating an aged appearance. The cup itself is rounded, with a slightly flared rim and horizontal grooves encircling its body. The green color of the cup is mottled with darker and lighter shades, giving a variegated effect. Beneath the cup and plate, there is a portion of a brown surface, likely representing a table or wooden base. Above the cup and plate, capitalized text reads "DRINKING CUP LATE 18th CENTURY," written in dark, serif lettering against a beige background. The overall composition centers the cup and plate with the descriptive text at the top.
title: Drinking Cup
